# html2canvas 1.4.1

`html2canvas.min.js` is the unmodified `dist/html2canvas.min.js` from the
npm package `html2canvas@1.4.1` (https://html2canvas.hertzen.com,
https://github.com/niklasvh/html2canvas), MIT License; see `LICENSE`.

SHA-256: `e87e550794322e574a1fda0c1549a3c70dae5a93d9113417a429016838eab8cb`

Used by `/js/liquid-glass.js` on phones only: it photographs the page so the
nav's WebGL lens can refract it (iPhone browsers cannot refract a backdrop
with an SVG filter). It is loaded on demand and never on computers.
